newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Macquarie lifts copper forecast.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Macquarie lifts copper forecast.

text.p: Macquarie Equities Ltd said on Thursday it had revised upward its average forecast price for copper next year to US$1.05 a pound from US$0.93 previously.

"This is in recognition of the temporary tightness in prices, which should be eased by mid-1997," Macquarie said in a report released on Wednesday. It said it expects copper to average US$1.20 a pound in the first quarter of calendar 1997.

Macquarie's latest forecast for an average aluminium price of US$0.75 a pound is 2.6 percent below its previous estimate, but about 10 percent above this year's expectation of a price of US$0.68. The higher price for next year reflects expectations of a small supply defict emerging after this year's small surplus.
"There are signs that consumers are beginning to return to the market after heavy de-stocking in 1996," the report said.
U.S. orders in particular have rallied strongly and in October were 10 percent up on a month-to-month basis, it said.
